sourceBindings.text: One-metre / three-emitter teaching brief. Positions and component shapes are schematic, not actual kit dimensions, hole sizes or a product demonstration. Select a component to inspect its role. An assembled picture is not a water test.
Match each component to its function
Tube
Carries water along the line
Three emitters
Release water near the three intended plants
Matching punch
Makes product-matched holes with the safe kit tool
End cap
Closes the downstream end
Supply connector
Joins the isolated line to its compatible supply
Upstream filter
Reduces particles that could block emitters
Kit-required pressure controls
Maintain/check the selected kit’s operating limits
Arrange a safe conceptual workflow

Each card must appear once. Layout and kit verification precede punching; punching precedes emitter seating; emitters, end closure and connector precede a test. Independent closures may change order where the real manual allows. This is reasoning practice, not permission to operate.
Lay out and name the disconnected components
Check PPE, tool compatibility and actual kit/manual limits
Measure one metre, mark three plant positions and use the kit-matched punch
Seat the three compatible emitters
Fit the downstream end cap
Fit the connector to the isolated, inactive line
Trainer-controlled test of all three outlets and joints; isolate before fault correction, retest and tidy

sourceBindings.text: For this supervised process-card exercise, use a trowel to take your own sample from the trainer-designated root zone of the provided planter box containing young plants in sandy loam. Record and interpret the actual moisture observations, then personally assemble and test a one-metre line with three emitters under trainer observation, using the verified compatible kit and its manual.
A compatible kit and its manufacturer instructions, including punch/emitter size and operating pressure/flow, must be recorded before detailed demonstration or actual water test.
Trainer observation: ten original checklist items
Suitable PPE used (for example, gloves appropriate to the task) and workspace made safe
Uses a trowel to take a sample from the active root zone; approximately 10–15 cm applies only to this planter-box exercise
Feel and appearance test personally performed and observations recorded
Moisture interpreted from actual evidence and texture, not a prescribed 'too dry' answer
Tubing, three emitters, punch, cap, connector and required filter/control components identified
One-metre compatible tube measured and three plant-aligned holes punched safely
Three compatible emitters firmly seated
End cap fitted securely
Source connector fitted per actual kit instructions
Trainer-controlled test confirms all three outputs and leak-free joints; student corrects faults safely and cleans up

sourceBindings.text: Trainer records student ID, actual sampling position/depth (source card offers approximately 10–15 cm for its planter box), texture, squeeze/ribbon/color/water-stain observations, moisture judgment and a texture-specific reason. The student reports the observed state, even if it is not dry.
Pass only on individual observed sampling and supported interpretation; a simulator click, group answer or scripted 'too dry' label does not pass.

Matches each listed component to its function and orders layout, kit-guided marking/punching, emitter seating, end closure, source connector, filtration/pressure verification, controlled water test and clean-up. No invented pressure, flow or hole-spacing numbers.
Pass when functions, sequence, kit compatibility and test boundary are correct; missing safety or kit verification triggers targeted retry.

Trainer witnesses the same student use the suitable PPE/tool, position three holes for three plants along a measured 1 m compatible tube, fit three emitters, cap and connect, then test under kit-specified operating conditions for secure joints, leaks and all three outputs, correct defects and tidy the site.
Pass only after all individual safety and functional checks are observed and signed. Any untested or leaking line remains unpassed until safely corrected and retested.

C01 and C03 pass only with trainer-recorded individual evidence for all applicable safety and functional checks; no fixed score substitution. Correct and retest any failure. C02 is assessed separately online.
